Get one poll

get_poll.Rd

Fetches one poll by numeric ID, including nested party results.

Usage

get_poll(poll_id, include_manual_review = FALSE, include_inactive = FALSE)

Arguments

poll_id

Numeric poll ID.

include_manual_review

Include polls in manual review.

include_inactive

Include inactive polls.

Value

A one-row tibble with a results list-column containing a tibble ordered by descending vote_share.

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  get_poll(101)
}
